original: Can you take my blood pressure or not?
features: can ... or not 正反问句式，省略助动词 do
literal_zh: 你能不能量我的血压或者不能。
standard_en: Could you please take my blood pressure?
medical_en: May I check your blood pressure now?
register_note: 正反问不带 please，直接对医护说略显生硬，加 please 更自然
meaning_zh: 请问您能帮我量一下血压吗。

original: I got fever since yesterday.
features: 用 got 代替 have，省略完成体与时间介词
standard_en: I have had a fever since yesterday.
medical_en: I have had a fever since yesterday, about thirty-eight degrees.
register_note: got 表状态，英文应改 have had，否则时间关系不清

original: I already take the medicine liao.
features: already 与 liao 并用表完成体，动词不变形
standard_en: I have already taken the medicine.
medical_en: I have already taken the medicine this morning.
register_note: 完成体靠 already 与 liao 标记，英文须用现在完成时

original: This one very pain lah.
features: 省略系动词与主语，lah 起缓和语气作用
standard_en: This is very painful.
medical_en: This area is very painful when touched.
register_note: 省略 be 动词，英文须补 is；lah 不必译出，用 please 承接语气

original: Where got so serious?
features: where got 反诘表否认，并非真在提问
standard_en: It is not that serious.
medical_en: I do not think it is that serious, but please check.
register_note: 反诘实为否认，英文用 it is not，不可照字面译成疑问

original: I cannot tahan the pain already.
features: cannot tahan 表无法忍受，already 表程度加深
standard_en: I cannot bear the pain anymore.
medical_en: The pain is unbearable; I need something for it now.
register_note: 表强烈痛苦，语气急迫，须立即评估疼痛评分

original: Doctor, I want to check up only.
features: only 后置表限定，省略主语与 be 动词
standard_en: I only want a check-up.
medical_en: I would just like a check-up, nothing else.
register_note: only 后置易被听成“只要检查”，英文须前置 only

original: My father he got diabetes.
features: 主语重复强调，got 代替 has 表拥有
standard_en: My father has diabetes.
medical_en: My father has diabetes and takes metformin.
register_note: 主语重复是口语强调，英文删去 he；got 改 has

original: Can or not, doctor?
features: can or not 独立成句，询问可行性
standard_en: Is it possible, doctor?
medical_en: Is it possible to do it today, doctor?
register_note: 独立疑问句，英文用 is it possible，不能直译

original: Wait ah, I go toilet first.
features: ah 为语气词，省略 will 与定冠词
standard_en: Wait, I go to the toilet first.
medical_en: Please wait a moment; I need to use the toilet first.
register_note: 省略助动词与冠词，英文补 will 与 the；ah 不译

original: This medicine eat already will sleepy one.
features: 话题前置，one 起名词化作用表必然结果
literal_zh: 这个药吃 already 会困的。
standard_en: This medicine, after eating, will make you sleepy.
medical_en: This medicine may make you drowsy after you take it.
register_note: 语序为话题前置，英文用 may make you drowsy，one 不译

original: I donno why like that.
features: donno 为 don't know 的合音，省略主语与系动词
literal_zh: 我不知道为什么像那样。
standard_en: I do not know why it is like that.
medical_en: I am not sure why this is happening.
register_note: 表困惑，语气随意，医护须用通俗语言重新解释
meaning_zh: 我不知道为什么会这样。

original: Got injection or not?
features: got 表存在，or not 构成正反问
standard_en: Is there an injection or not?
medical_en: Will I need an injection?
register_note: 存在疑问，英文用 will I need，不可译成 is there

original: The nurse say must fast, is it?
features: 尾问 is it 表求确认，主句省略时态
standard_en: The nurse said I must fast, is that right?
medical_en: The nurse said I need to fast before the test, is that correct?
register_note: is it 是尾问标记，英文用 is that right 或 correct

original: I never eat pork one.
features: never 表一般否定，one 起名词化作用
standard_en: I do not eat pork.
medical_en: I do not eat pork for religious reasons.
register_note: never 实为 do not，英文须改一般现在时否定

original: Very shiok after the massage.
features: shiok 表非常舒服，句首省略主谓结构
standard_en: It felt very good after the massage.
medical_en: The massage helped; I feel much more comfortable now.
register_note: 描述体验而非疗效，英文用 felt good，不可写入病情

original: Don't blur blur, listen carefully.
features: blur 重叠表状态，属直接命令句式，语气偏重
standard_en: Do not be confused; listen carefully.
medical_en: Please pay attention; I will explain the instructions again.
register_note: 带轻微责备，对患者宜改为 please pay attention

original: He kiasu, want to do all the tests.
features: kiasu 形容词作谓语，本身带贬义色彩
standard_en: He is afraid to lose out, so he wants all the tests.
medical_en: He is anxious about missing something and requests all tests.
register_note: kiasu 含贬义，英文用 anxious，沟通时解释检查必要性
meaning_zh: 他怕吃亏，什么检查都想做。

original: Paiseh, can you say again?
features: paiseh 作客气开场，并非正式道歉用语
literal_zh: 不好意思，你能再说一次吗。
standard_en: Sorry to trouble you, could you say that again?
medical_en: I am sorry to trouble you; could you repeat that more slowly?
register_note: 客气开场，语气礼貌，适合用于请对方重复一遍
meaning_zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍吗。

original: Can tapao the medicine?
features: tapao 表打包带走，can 表请求许可
standard_en: Could I take the medicine away?
medical_en: Could I collect the medicine and take it home?
register_note: 取药场景用 collect，不能直译成 pack

original: I chope the seat already.
features: chope 表占座，already 表完成
standard_en: I have already reserved the seat.
medical_en: I have saved this seat for my family member.
register_note: 涉及候诊秩序，英文用 reserved，医护宜说明规则

original: Go makan first then come back.
features: makan 表吃饭，省略主语与助动词 will
standard_en: Go and eat first, then come back.
medical_en: Please have your meal first, then come back for the test.
register_note: 省略主谓，英文补 please；makan 改 have a meal

original: That ang moh patient cannot speak Chinese.
features: ang moh 指白人，属标签化口语称呼
literal_zh: 那个红毛病人不会说中文。
standard_en: That Western patient cannot speak Chinese.
medical_en: That patient is a foreign national and needs an interpreter.
register_note: 不可当面使用 ang moh，英文用 foreign patient 或写明国籍
meaning_zh: 那位外国患者不会说中文。

original: Don't sabo me leh.
features: sabo 表坑害，leh 起请求语气作用
standard_en: Please do not make things difficult for me.
medical_en: Please help me with this rather than raising obstacles.
register_note: sabo 属抱怨，正式沟通用 make things difficult

original: He steady one, don't worry.
features: steady 表可靠，one 起名词化作用
standard_en: He is reliable, so do not worry.
medical_en: He is experienced and reliable, so you are in good hands.
register_note: steady 指人可靠，不可用来描述生命体征

original: This hospital very atas one.
features: atas 表高档，句首省略系动词 be 与主语
standard_en: This hospital is quite upmarket.
medical_en: This hospital is a private facility with higher charges.
register_note: 带评判意味，正式沟通宜改为 private facility

original: My house very ulu, ambulance slow.
features: ulu 表偏僻，两个分句均省略系动词 be
standard_en: My house is remote, so the ambulance was slow.
medical_en: I live in a remote area; the ambulance took a long time to arrive.
register_note: ulu 指地点，英文用 remote area，涉及转运须写具体地址
meaning_zh: 我家很偏僻，救护车来得很慢。

original: I stay kampung, far from hospital.
features: kampung 表乡村，stay 表居住
standard_en: I live in a village far from the hospital.
medical_en: I live in a village about two hours from the hospital.
register_note: stay 在本地英语里表居住，英文用 live
meaning_zh: 我住在乡下，离医院很远。

original: My handphone no battery.
features: handphone 表手机，省略系动词与冠词
standard_en: My mobile phone battery is flat.
medical_en: My mobile phone has run out of battery; here is another number.
register_note: 陈述事实，语气中性，医护可主动提供备用联系方式

original: Aiyo, so pain!
features: aiyo 表心疼或着急，句首省略主语谓语
standard_en: Oh no, it is so painful.
medical_en: Oh no, the pain is severe; let me check it now.
register_note: 感叹词需承接情绪，英文用 oh no，不可省略

original: Wah lao, the queue so long.
features: wah lao 表无奈，省略系动词 be
standard_en: Oh my, the queue is so long.
medical_en: I am sorry about the wait; the queue is longer than usual.
register_note: 感叹词不含攻击性，英文用 oh my，并回应等候时间

original: This form very cheem, I don't understand.
features: cheem 表难懂，句首省略系动词与主语
standard_en: This form is very complicated and I do not understand it.
medical_en: This form is difficult to understand; let me explain it item by item.
register_note: 涉及知情同意，英文须改用通俗语言重新解释
meaning_zh: 这张表太难懂，我看不明白。

original: I sian already, take medicine every day.
features: sian 表厌烦，already 表程度
standard_en: I am tired of taking medicine every day.
medical_en: I feel worn down by taking medicine daily and need support.
register_note: 持续厌烦可能是抑郁信号，英文用 tired of，需进一步评估

original: I shag already, cannot walk.
features: shag 表极度疲惫，already 表程度加深
standard_en: I am exhausted and cannot walk.
medical_en: I am too exhausted to walk; I need a wheelchair.
register_note: shag 程度强，英文用 exhausted，需评估器质性原因

original: Ownself cannot sign, is it?
features: ownself 表独自，尾问 is it
standard_en: Can I not sign for myself?
medical_en: Do I need a family member to sign on my behalf?
register_note: ownself 改 by myself，签字问题须核代理权限

original: Go where? I bring you.
features: go where 表问候或问路，省略助动词
standard_en: Where are you going? I will take you there.
medical_en: Which department are you looking for? I will show you the way.
register_note: 问候与问路两义，英文用 which department 更明确

original: What to do, no money.
features: what to do 表无奈，省略主语与 be
standard_en: There is no choice; I have no money.
medical_en: I cannot afford the treatment; what options are available?
register_note: 表经济困难，英文用 cannot afford，并可转介医疗救助

original: Balik kampung next week, can reschedule?
features: balik kampung 表返乡，省略主语
literal_zh: 回甘榜下周，可以改期吗。
standard_en: I am going back to my hometown next week; can we reschedule?
medical_en: I will return to my hometown next week; could the follow-up be moved?
register_note: 涉及随访中断，英文用 return to hometown，并安排异地就医
meaning_zh: 下周我要返乡，复诊能改期吗。

original: Got meh? I never take this medicine.
features: got meh 表怀疑，never 表否定
literal_zh: 有吗，我从来没有吃这个药。
standard_en: Is that really so? I have never taken this medicine.
medical_en: I do not think so; I have never taken this medicine before.
register_note: 表怀疑而非确认，英文用 I do not think so，须核对记录
meaning_zh: 有吗，我从没吃过这个药。

original: How can like that, wait so long.
features: how can 表不满，省略系动词与主语
literal_zh: 怎么能像那样，等这么久。
standard_en: How can it be like that? We waited so long.
medical_en: This wait is not acceptable; could you tell us the expected time?
register_note: 表投诉，英文用 not acceptable，进入投诉回应流程

original: What time already, still not my turn.
features: what time already 表抱怨时间晚
literal_zh: 什么时间了，还没轮到我。
standard_en: It is already so late and it is still not my turn.
medical_en: It is already very late and I still have not been seen.
register_note: 表抱怨，英文用 it is already late，回应等候与分级

original: Already eat or not?
features: already 与 or not 组合问完成
standard_en: Have you eaten or not?
medical_en: Have you eaten anything in the last six hours?
register_note: 完成体疑问，英文用 have you eaten，须加时间范围

original: You want injection one or tablet one?
features: one 名词化表选择，两处均省略了定冠词
literal_zh: 你要打针的一个还是药片的一个。
standard_en: Do you want the injection or the tablets?
medical_en: Would you prefer the injection or the oral tablets?
register_note: 选择疑问，英文用 would you prefer，one 不译

original: I blur, which room?
features: blur 表搞不清状况，句首省略了系动词
standard_en: I am confused; which room is it?
medical_en: I am not sure which room I should go to.
register_note: blur 指没搞清楚，英文用 not sure，指引时写清楼层

original: Later he sure scold me one.
features: later 表将来，one 表必然结果，均属口语
standard_en: He will certainly scold me later.
medical_en: I am worried my family will be upset with me later.
register_note: 表担忧而非事实，英文用 worried，涉及家属沟通可介入

original: This one can use one, is it?
features: one 双重名词化，is it 构成尾问
standard_en: Can this one be used, is that right?
medical_en: Is it all right to use this one?
register_note: 指代不清，英文用 this one，须确认具体物品

original: I got allergy one, not sure what.
features: got 表有，one 名词化，省略关系词
literal_zh: 我有过敏的，不确定什么。
standard_en: I have an allergy, but I am not sure to what.
medical_en: I have had an allergic reaction before, but I do not know the trigger.
register_note: 过敏史不明须追问药物与食物，英文用 allergic reaction
meaning_zh: 我有过敏，但不知道是什么。

original: No need lah, I fine.
features: no need 表不必，lah 缓和，fine 省略系动词
standard_en: No need, I am fine.
medical_en: I do not need it, thank you; I am feeling all right.
register_note: 拒绝帮助但可能客气，英文用 thank you，须确认是否真无需求

original: Just now I fall down, now ok already.
features: just now 表刚才，already 表恢复
standard_en: I fell down just now, but I am fine now.
medical_en: I fell a short while ago; the pain has settled now.
register_note: 跌倒史须记录时间与部位，英文用 a short while ago
meaning_zh: 我刚才摔了一跤，现在没事了。

original: Sorry, I catch no ball.
features: catch no ball 为习语，表完全听不懂
standard_en: Sorry, I do not understand at all.
medical_en: I am sorry, I did not understand any of that.
register_note: 习语不可直译，英文用 do not understand，改通俗解释

original: Can I go toilet or not?
features: can ... or not 正反问，省略冠词
literal_zh: 我可以去厕所或者不能。
standard_en: Can I go to the toilet or not?
medical_en: May I use the toilet, please?
register_note: 加 please 更礼貌，英文用 may I

original: I got take medicine already.
features: got 加动词原形表完成，already 重复标记
standard_en: I have already taken my medicine.
medical_en: I have already taken my medicine today.
register_note: 陈述已完成，语气随意，医护须核对服药时间与剂量

original: He not coming today, he got work.
features: 省略 be 动词，got 表拥有，此处指有工作
standard_en: He is not coming today because he has work.
medical_en: He cannot come today because of work commitments.
register_note: 英文补 is 与 because，got 改 has

original: You want to follow me go?
features: follow 表同行，省略不定式 to，口语常见
standard_en: Do you want to come along with me?
medical_en: Would you like to come with me to the clinic?
register_note: follow 实为同行，英文用 come along

original: Can you send me to hospital?
features: send 表送人，省略定冠词 the 与 be
standard_en: Could you take me to the hospital?
medical_en: Could you arrange transport to the hospital for me?
register_note: send 在本地表送人，英文用 take 或 transport

original: I wait for you at the lobby, fetch me can?
features: fetch 表接人，can 独立构成尾问
literal_zh: 我在大厅等你，接我可以吗。
standard_en: I will wait for you at the lobby; can you pick me up?
medical_en: I will be waiting in the lobby; could you come and get me?
register_note: fetch 表接人，英文用 pick up，加 could 更礼貌
meaning_zh: 我在大厅等你，能来接我吗。

original: Open the light, please.
features: open 代替 turn on，省略主语 you
standard_en: Please open the light.
medical_en: Please turn on the light.
register_note: open 与 turn on 混用，英文须用 turn on

original: Got money or not? Must pay deposit.
features: got 表拥有，or not 构成正反问
literal_zh: 有钱或者没有，必须付押金。
standard_en: Do you have money? You must pay a deposit.
medical_en: Do you have a means of payment? A deposit is required.
register_note: 涉及费用隐私，英文用 means of payment 更得体

original: How can like that one?
features: how can 表不满，one 起名词化作用
standard_en: How can it be like that?
medical_en: That is not acceptable; could you explain why this happened?
register_note: 表投诉，英文用 not acceptable，避免 one 直译

original: So how, want to admit or not?
features: so how 表追问，省略主语与助动词 do
standard_en: So what now, do you want to be admitted or not?
medical_en: So what would you like to do about admission?
register_note: so how 显得催促，英文用 what would you like

original: Steady lah, don't worry.
features: steady 表可靠，lah 起缓和语气作用
standard_en: It is all right, do not worry.
medical_en: You are in good hands; please do not worry.
register_note: 表安慰，英文用 you are in good hands，不可写入体征

original: Adui, very pain lah!
features: adui 表疼痛感叹，lah 起加强语气作用
standard_en: Ouch, it is very painful.
medical_en: Ouch, that is very painful when you press there.
register_note: 感叹需承接，英文用 ouch，追问疼痛部位

original: Don't potong queue, please.
features: potong queue 表插队，potong 为马来语借词
standard_en: Please do not jump the queue.
medical_en: Please follow the queue; do not jump ahead.
register_note: potong queue 表插队，英文用 jump the queue

original: Last time I got operation.
features: last time 表以前，got 表经历
standard_en: I had an operation previously.
medical_en: I had surgery before, about two years ago.
register_note: last time 指以前，英文用 previously，并追问时间

original: On the way already, ten minutes.
features: on the way 表在路上，省略主语
standard_en: I am already on the way, ten minutes.
medical_en: I am on my way and will arrive in about ten minutes.
register_note: 时间弹性大，英文补 will arrive in about
meaning_zh: 我已经在路上了，大约十分钟到。

original: Makan already, can take medicine?
features: makan 表吃饭，already 表完成
standard_en: I have eaten; can I take the medicine?
medical_en: I have already eaten; may I take the medicine now?
register_note: 须核实进食时间与药物关系，英文明确 have eaten
meaning_zh: 我吃过饭了，可以吃药吗。

original: Tapau this porridge, please.
features: tapau 表打包带走，省略主语与定冠词
standard_en: Please pack this porridge for takeaway.
medical_en: Could you pack this porridge so I can take it away?
register_note: 涉及禁食医嘱，英文用 take away，须确认是否进食

original: Gostan the car first.
features: gostan 表倒车，属马来语借词的口语用法
standard_en: Reverse the car first.
medical_en: Please reverse the vehicle first.
register_note: gostan 仅本地使用，英文用 reverse

original: My leg got water one.
features: got water 表水肿，one 名词化
standard_en: My leg has water in it.
medical_en: My leg is swollen with fluid.
register_note: got water 指水肿，英文用 swollen，不可译成有积水

original: He got sugar one.
features: sugar 表糖尿病，one 起名词化作用
standard_en: He has sugar.
medical_en: He has diabetes.
register_note: sugar 指糖尿病，英文用 diabetes，避免歧义

original: This one very expensive one, got discount or not?
features: one 名词化，got 构成存在疑问句，属口语
literal_zh: 这个很贵，有折扣或者没有。
standard_en: This is very expensive; is there a discount or not?
medical_en: This treatment is costly; are there any subsidies or discounts?
register_note: 费用沟通，英文用 subsidies or discounts 更准确

original: I not sure, you ask my son.
features: 省略 be 动词，you ask 表请求
standard_en: I am not sure; please ask my son.
medical_en: I am not sure; my son handles these decisions.
register_note: 补 be 动词与 please，涉及代理须确认授权
meaning_zh: 我不确定，你问我儿子吧。

original: Wait, I check with my wife first.
features: 省略 will，check with 表商量
standard_en: Wait, I will check with my wife first.
medical_en: Please give me a moment; I need to discuss it with my wife.
register_note: family deliberation 常见，英文用 discuss
meaning_zh: 等一下，我先和我妻子商量。

original: Doctor, my body very heaty one.
features: heaty 表上火，属中医式日常表达，非医学诊断
standard_en: Doctor, my body is very heaty.
medical_en: Doctor, I feel hot inside and have a sore throat.
register_note: heaty 非医学概念，英文须改写为具体症状

original: I got no appetite since two days ago.
features: got no 表没有，since 表时间起点

standard_en: I have had no appetite since two days ago.

original: You better sit down first, later faint.
features: 省略主语与连词，later 表将来危险后果

original: He always come late one.
features: 一般现在时第三人称不加 s，one 名词化
standard_en: He always comes late.
medical_en: He usually arrives late for appointments.

original: Can one, no problem.
features: can 单独成句表许可，one 起弱化作用
standard_en: Yes, it can be done, no problem.
medical_en: Yes, that is possible; there is no problem.
register_note: 表许可，英文用 that is possible，避免直译

original: I scare injection one.
features: scare 当动词用，省略 be，one 名词化

medical_en: I am afraid of needles; could you explain before you give it?
register_note: scare 应为 am scared，英文补系动词

original: My blood pressure high one, take medicine also same.
features: 省略系动词，also same 表无改善

features: not yet eat 表未进食，can ... or not 正反问
literal_zh: 还没吃，可以做血检或者不。

medical_en: I have not eaten yet; may I have the blood test now?
register_note: 需核实空腹时长，英文用 have not eaten
meaning_zh: 我还没吃东西，可以抽血吗。

original: Where got so many medicine one?
features: where got 反诘，one 名词化
standard_en: How can there be so many medicines?
medical_en: Why do I need so many medicines?

original: Everyday I walk to clinic, very far one.
features: everyday 作副词，one 名词化

meaning_zh: 我每天走路去诊所，很远。

features: 转述医嘱省略 that，how 表不知如何执行
literal_zh: 医生说不能吃盐，但我不知道怎样。

medical_en: The doctor advised a low-salt diet, but I am not sure how to do it.
register_note: 医嘱转述不清，英文用 low-salt diet 并给具体做法
meaning_zh: 医生说不能吃盐，但我不知道怎么办。

original: He gone already, went back just now.
features: gone 表离开，just now 表刚才
literal_zh: 他走了已经，刚才回去的。
standard_en: He has already left; he went back just now.
medical_en: He has already left and went home a short while ago.

meaning_zh: 他已经走了，刚才回去的。

original: Where is the CR, ma'am?
features: CR 为 comfort room 缩写，ma'am 表敬称
standard_en: Where is the comfort room, ma'am?
medical_en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

original: May I go to the CR first?
features: 保留 may I 礼貌式，CR 为厕所缩写
standard_en: May I go to the comfort room first?
medical_en: May I use the restroom before the test?
register_note: 英文用 restroom，保留 may I 的礼貌

original: There was a brownout last night.
features: brownout 表停电，非电压下降或棕发

original: Please open the light, it's dark.

original: Close the light when you leave.
features: close 代替 turn off，与开关动词混用
standard_en: Close the light when you leave.
medical_en: Please turn off the light when you leave.

features: for a while 表请稍候，时长模糊

standard_en: Please wait for a while; the doctor is coming.
medical_en: Please wait a moment; the doctor will be with you shortly.
register_note: 时长不确定，英文加 shortly 给预期

original: The aircon is too cold.
features: aircon 为 air conditioning 缩写

medical_en: The air conditioning is too cold; could you adjust it?

original: Put the insulin in the ref.
features: ref 为 refrigerator 缩写
standard_en: Put the insulin in the refrigerator.
medical_en: Please keep the insulin in the refrigerator at two to eight degrees.
register_note: 英文用 refrigerator，并注明温度

original: She was admitted last week for confinement.
features: confinement 表住院或分娩，非限制
standard_en: She was admitted last week for confinement.

original: He was salvaged, according to the police.

meaning_zh: 据警方说，他是被私刑处死的。

medical_en: I was referred by our village health worker.
register_note: 英文用 village health worker，便于核对转诊链

original: My car was carnapped yesterday.
features: carnap 为 car 与 kidnap 缩合，表偷车
standard_en: My car was carnapped yesterday.
medical_en: My car was stolen yesterday.

original: I need a medical certificate for work.
features: medical certificate 实指病假证明

standard_en: I need a medical certificate for work.

features: admitted 表住院，非被接纳或承认

medical_en: I was hospitalized for two days.

features: schedule 表预约号源，非工作日程表

medical_en: Do you have an appointment available tomorrow?

features: companion 表陪同者，非配偶或伴侣

meaning_zh: 陪我来的那位会来取结果。

original: Please fall in line here.
features: fall in line 表排队，非跌倒或失败

medical_en: Please queue here in a single line.

original: The ward boy will bring the wheelchair.
features: ward boy 表病房护工，非男孩称呼
standard_en: The ward boy will bring the wheelchair.
medical_en: The ward attendant will bring the wheelchair.
register_note: ward boy 不专业，英文用 ward attendant

original: I have a check-up with my doctor.
features: check-up 表复诊或体检，需按语境判断
standard_en: I have a check-up with my doctor.

register_note: check-up 在此指复诊，英文用 follow-up

original: Kindly endorse me to the ER.
features: endorse 表转介，非签名背书或推荐

register_note: endorse 实为转介，英文用 refer

features: go ahead 表先行告辞，非继续前进
standard_en: I will go ahead, ma'am.
medical_en: I will be leaving now, ma'am.
register_note: go ahead 在此表告辞，英文用 leaving

standard_en: It is the same but different.

meaning_zh: 有点一样但又不太一样。

medical_en: I am not allowed to go home today.

register_note: 英文用 not available，避免 no have
meaning_zh: 这里没有这个药，我可以去外面买吗。

original: Finish already, can go back?
features: finish already 表完成，省略主语
standard_en: It is finished; can I go back?
medical_en: The treatment is finished; may I go home now?

meaning_zh: 做完了，我可以回去了吗。

standard_en: I am not so good today.
medical_en: I am not feeling well today.

original: Take care, see you next week.

medical_en: Take care; see you at the follow-up next week.
register_note: 英文用 at the follow-up 更明确

medical_en: That is fine; I can come for the appointment.

standard_en: I cannot eat; I am not hungry.

register_note: 表食欲差，英文用 no appetite

original: Doctor say stop medicine, I stop already.

medical_en: The doctor told me to stop the medicine, and I have stopped it.
register_note: 英文用 told me to stop，明确医嘱
meaning_zh: 医生说停药，我已经停了。

original: My mother old already, cannot walk.
features: old already 表年迈，省略 be
standard_en: My mother is old already and cannot walk.
medical_en: My mother is elderly and cannot walk.
register_note: 英文用 elderly，避免 old 的贬义
meaning_zh: 我母亲年纪大了，走不了路。

original: This medicine make me sleepy a lot.
features: make 缺第三人称 s，a lot 表程度
standard_en: This medicine makes me sleepy a lot.
medical_en: This medicine makes me very drowsy.
register_note: 陈述副作用，语气中性，须补剂量与出现时间

original: Price same same last time?
features: same same 表相同，省略 as 与 be
standard_en: Is the price the same as last time?
medical_en: Is the price the same as my last visit?
register_note: 英文用 as my last visit，避免歧义

original: Tomorrow I come again, can?
features: can 尾问表请求许可，省略 may I
standard_en: Can I come again tomorrow?
medical_en: May I come back tomorrow?
register_note: 尾问 can 显生硬，英文用 may I

original: I go back first, thank you.
features: go back first 表先行告辞，非顺序第一
standard_en: I will go back first, thank you.
medical_en: I will be leaving now, thank you.
register_note: 英文用 leaving now，避免 first 歧义

original: Already eat, doctor.
features: already 表完成体，省略 have 助动词
standard_en: I have already eaten, doctor.
medical_en: I have already eaten, doctor.
register_note: 极简陈述，礼貌度低但无冒犯，宜复述核对确认

original: Can not can do the test today?
features: can not can 正反问，表可行与否
standard_en: Can or cannot do the test today?
medical_en: Is it possible to do the test today?
register_note: 英文用 is it possible，不直译

original: What jam is my appointment?
features: jam 表钟点，并非果酱或交通堵塞的意思
standard_en: What time is my appointment?
medical_en: What time is my appointment?
register_note: jam 须译成 time，避免 jam 歧义

original: Where go for X-ray?
features: where go 省略助动词，表问去哪个科室
standard_en: Where do I go for the X-ray?
medical_en: Where should I go for the X-ray?
register_note: 直接问路，省略助动词，加 excuse me 更得体

original: Not yet take medicine.
features: not yet 表尚未，省略 have 助动词
standard_en: I have not taken the medicine yet.
medical_en: I have not taken the medicine yet.
register_note: 英文补 have not，避免与拒绝混淆

original: I sick here since yesterday.
features: sick 表疼痛，since 表时间起点
standard_en: I am sick here since yesterday.
medical_en: It has been painful here since yesterday.
register_note: sick 在本地可指疼痛，英文用 painful

original: I take medicine from pharmacy already.
features: take 表取药，already 表完成
standard_en: I have already taken medicine from the pharmacy.
medical_en: I have already collected the medicine from the pharmacy.
register_note: 英文用 collected，区分取药与服药
meaning_zh: 我已经从药房取过药了。

original: Wait yes, I call my family first.
features: wait yes 表请稍候，yes 缓和
literal_zh: 等是的，我先打电话家人。
standard_en: Wait, yes, I will call my family first.
medical_en: Please wait a moment; I need to call my family first.
register_note: 英文加 please，wait yes 不直译
meaning_zh: 等一下，我先给家人打个电话。

original: Sorry yes, I don't understand.

standard_en: Sorry, yes, I do not understand.
medical_en: I am sorry, I do not understand.
register_note: sorry yes 仅表客气，英文用 I am sorry

original: Not allowed to eat before test, right?

register_note: 用 right 求确认，语气中性，须明确回答是或不是

original: I go first, thank you.
features: go first 表先行告辞，非插队抢先
standard_en: I will go first, thank you.
medical_en: I will be leaving now, thank you.
register_note: 英文用 leaving now，避免误解为插队

original: Medicine already, can I eat now?
features: medicine already 表已服药，省略动词
standard_en: The medicine is already taken; can I eat now?
medical_en: I have taken the medicine; may I eat now?
register_note: 陈述加请求，语气自然，须核对服药与进食间隔
meaning_zh: 药已经吃了，现在能吃东西吗。

original: Wait first, the nurse said.
features: wait first 表先等，first 表顺序
standard_en: Wait first, the nurse said.
medical_en: Please wait first, as the nurse said.
register_note: 转述他人指令，语气略生硬，宜加 please

original: How much jam to wait?
features: jam 表时长单位，此处是问需要等待多久
standard_en: How many hours do I have to wait?
medical_en: How long do I have to wait?
register_note: jam 在此表时长，英文用 how long

original: My child sick, very high fever.
features: sick 表生病，省略 be，程度靠 very
standard_en: My child is sick with a very high fever.
medical_en: My child is unwell with a high fever.

original: Can I pay by card or not can?
features: can ... or not can 正反问表可行
standard_en: Can I pay by card or not?
medical_en: Can I pay by card?
register_note: or not can 不直译，英文用 can I pay

original: The doctor said no have bed, is it true?
features: no have 表没有，is it true 表确认
standard_en: The doctor said there is no bed; is that true?
medical_en: The doctor said there are no beds available; is that correct?
register_note: 英文用 no beds available
meaning_zh: 医生说没有床位，是真的吗。

original: I already finish the antibiotic, three days ago.
features: already 与明确过去时间重复使用，属冗余

standard_en: I have already finished the antibiotic, three days ago.
medical_en: I finished the antibiotic three days ago.
register_note: already 与过去时间重复，英文用一般过去时

original: Sorry, I come late because jam.

original: Tomorrow I come back, what jam?
features: what jam 表几点，疑问语序倒装，属口语

medical_en: What time should I come back tomorrow?
register_note: 直接询问时间，语气中性，加 please 更礼貌
